name: Progress photos: add from camera or gallery, view and zoom, change the date, save to phone gallery, compare two, share before and after
Build a plan: answer goal, level, days, equipment, sore areas, leave out exercises, then save or save and follow the plan (rules only, no AI, offline)
Find a plan: browse ready programs (full gym, dumbbells, home), open one, follow it or save it to my routines
Pick any exercise to see its lift trend (Your lifts, Any exercise)
Monthly report and year in review: numbers, coach note, change against the period before, records, muscles, favourites, step between periods, share as a picture
Edit a routine: rename, add, reorder, swap or remove exercises, sets, warm-ups, rest, supersets, notes, share, move folder, duplicate, delete, start
Guided first routine: name a folder, name a routine, pick exercises, check and save (with Skip)
Routine preview: read a routine's exercises, sets, rest and notes, then Start or Edit
Log a live workout: log sets, rest timer, minimise, add or swap exercises mid-workout, undo, discard, finish
Workout summary after Finish: time, sets, kg lifted against last time, records, add photos, update the routine, share
A saved workout's page: stats, sets, photos, share as picture or text, save as routine, repeat, edit, delete
Start or resume a workout from the home-screen Today widget (link forgeai://workout/start)
Settings home: one page of six groups (You, Workouts, Your gym, Phone and watch, Your data, Help), each row showing how it is set now
switch: rows shown by: gym joined, FEATURES.coach, MettleUp Plus gate (MEMBER_PLAN_GATE_ON), iPhone, watch present, health apps present

name: Workout settings: rest timer and sounds, weekly goal, plates and bars, rate how hard each set felt, more workout choices (next weight, previous numbers, muscle tips)
Units (kg and km, or lb and miles) and Light or dark (same as phone, light, dark)
Reminders: workout reminder days and time, and with a gym joined, reminders and messages from my gym on or off
switch: gym switches show only with a gym joined; the Reminders row is left out on iPhone

name: AI coach settings: provider, model, keys and voice (page sends you to Settings while the coach is switched off)
Your gym settings: gym logo on my home screen, leave my gym, and What my gym can see (name on leaderboard, gym mates see my workouts, share machines I use, share workouts with my trainers)
switch: needs a gym joined; switches appear by gym server version and gym features (branding, Busy machines, trainer view); FEATURES.gymSync (false) hides the cloud card

name: Phone and watch: install or open MettleUp on my watch, send workouts to health apps, home-screen widgets
switch: watch row only with a watch; health row only on a build with Health Connect; group shows a not-yet note on iPhone

name: Backup and restore: MettleUp account backup, Download my data, Restore from a backup file, bring back an old Google Drive backup; plus the unlinked Android phone-backup page kept only for the cloud test
Take my data out: save history and measurements as a spreadsheet, and share a text of my last 4 weeks to an AI app
Bring in from Hevy or Strong: past workouts from an export file (replace or merge) and routines from a Hevy share link (import screens sit outside this helper's file range; read by header only)
Erase or start over: remove the demo data, or erase everything
Help and feedback: type or speak a message to MettleUp, add my watch's screen log, see my questions and the answers, floating feedback button on or off
switch: an AI answer uses the gym's AI credits (none without a gym); watch log only with a watch log on the phone

name: What's new (last 3 updates, each with a try-it button) and About (credits, app version)

not a feature: old addresses that only send the member on to the page that replaced them (routines, settings/details, settings/workouts, progress tab, analytics, bodyweight, history, library, measurements, the app's start address, unknown address)
Gym shop: a product's page, the bag, place an order (pay at the desk), my orders with status and cancel
switch: gym feature 'shop' and the gym listing at least one product (apps/mobile/src/shop/ShopScreen.tsx:165); needs a gym joined

name: Gym messages: the inbox of messages from my gym, Message your gym (question, feedback, complaint), and ask a trainer about a workout
switch: needs a gym joined; 'A trainer' side shows only to a member with a running paid gym plan (askShown 'open', apps/mobile/src/shop/GymTalkScreen.tsx:5)

name: Diet plan from my gym's trainer (read-only)
switch: gym feature 'trainerPlans' and a diet plan sent (apps/mobile/src/shop/ShopScreen.tsx:333); needs a gym joined

name: Gym timings: open or closed now, the week's hours, special days, the gym's note
switch: needs a gym joined; any further switch unknown

name: A gym mate's shared workouts, opened from the gym leaderboard
switch: needs a gym joined; the mate must have 'Show my name' and 'Let my gym mates see my workouts' on (apps/mobile/src/app/settings/gym-sees.tsx:8); leaderboard needs gym feature 'challenge'

name: not a feature: test-build-only links (mettleup://qa-signin, qa-intro, qa-plan, qa-dots, qa-help, qa-look, qa-push, qa-sleep, qa-update) that set up made-up states for the cloud phone tests; store builds ignore them
switch: QA build stand-ins written into app.json by qa-device.yml

name: not a feature: the app's frame (root layout, the tab bar layout, and the handler for every link the phone hands the app); outside this helper's file range, read by header only

switch: FEATURES.coach and FEATURES.nutrition (code constants, both false in apps/mobile/src/lib/features.ts:6)

name: Workout tab and what opens from it: Up next card, see today's workout before starting, quick workout for the time I have, which muscles are ready today (outside this helper's file range, read by header only)
switch: none seen in the file headers; body not read

name: Profile tab and its pages: profile and history chart, edit my profile, badges, calendar, statistics, all records, credits (outside this helper's file range, read by header only)
switch: none seen in the file headers; body not read (paid part 'olderCharts' may apply to charts: unknown)

name: Exercise library: the exercises list, one exercise's page (summary, history, how to), hidden exercises, create or edit my own exercise, 1-rep max calculator (outside this helper's file range, read by header only)
switch: MettleUp Plus paid parts 'calculators' (apps/mobile/src/app/one-rep-max.tsx:33) and 'ownExercises'; the gate MEMBER_PLAN_GATE_ON is false (packages/theme/src/memberPlan.ts:28), so open to all today

name: Body measures: body weight, ten measurements and photos on one page with a graph, add a day's entry, trainer's measurements shown as From my gym (outside this helper's file range, read by header only)
Gym tab: join my gym, the gym's home, join by invite link (forgeai://j), check in by QR link (forgeai://c) and the poster scanner (outside this helper's file range, read by header only)

name: MettleUp Plus (free and paid parts, three prices, buy through Google Play in test mode) and Find my gym (prove my number by WhatsApp, join the gym that has me, or tell my gym); outside this helper's file range, read by header only
